units.text: INT. FAN - CONTINUOUS
Now, Lord Darlington.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Rising and crossing R. , front of him .
Don’t stir, I am merely going to finish my flowers.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Goes to table R.C.
Rising and moving chair .
And I must say I think you are very hard on modern life, Lady Windermere. Of course there is much against it, I admit. Most women, for instance, nowadays, are rather mercenary.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Don’t talk about such people.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Well then, setting aside mercenary people, who, of course, are dreadful, do you think seriously that women who have committed what the world calls a fault should never be forgiven?
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Standing at table .
I think they should never be forgiven.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: And men? Do you think that there should be the same laws for men as there are for women?
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Certainly!
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: I think life too complex a thing to be settled by these hard and fast rules.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: If we had ‘these hard and fast rules,’ we should find life much more simple.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: You allow of no exceptions?
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: None!
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Ah, what a fascinating Puritan you are, Lady Windermere!
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: The adjective was unnecessary, Lord Darlington.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: I couldn’t help it. I can resist everything except temptation.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: You have the modern affectation of weakness.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Looking at her .
It’s only an affectation, Lady Windermere.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Enter PARKER C.
The Duchess of Berwick and Lady Agatha Carlisle.
units.name: PARKER

units.text: Enter the DUCHESS OF BERWICK and LADY AGATHA CARLISLE C.
Exit PARKER C.
Coming down C. , and shaking hands .
Dear Margaret, I am so pleased to see you. You remember Agatha, don’t you?
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Crossing L.C.
How do you do, Lord Darlington? I won’t let you know my daughter, you are far too wicked.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Don’t say that, Duchess. As a wicked man I am a complete failure. Why, there are lots of people who say I have never really done anything wrong in the whole course of my life. Of course they only say it behind my back.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: Isn’t he dreadful? Agatha, this is Lord Darlington. Mind you don’t believe a word he says.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: LORD DARLINGTON crosses R.C.
No, no tea, thank you, dear.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Crosses and sits on sofa .

We have just had tea at Lady Markby’s. Such bad tea, too. It was quite undrinkable. I wasn’t at all surprised. Her own son-in-law supplies it. Agatha is looking forward so much to your ball to-night, dear Margaret.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: Seated L.C.
Oh, you mustn’t think it is going to be a ball, Duchess. It is only a dance in honour of my birthday. A small and early.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: Standing L.C.
Very small, very early, and very select, Duchess.
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON

units.text: On sofa L.

Of course it’s going to be select. But we know that , dear Margaret, about your house. It is really one of the few houses in London where I can take Agatha, and where I feel perfectly secure about dear Berwick. I don’t know what society is coming to. The most dreadful people seem to go everywhere. They certainly come to my parties—the men get quite furious if one doesn’t ask them. Really, some one should make a stand against it.
units.name: DUCHESS OF BERWICK

units.text: I will, Duchess. I will have no one in my house about whom there is any scandal.
units.name: LADY WINDERMERE

units.text: R.C.
Oh, don’t say that, Lady Windermere. I should never be admitted!
units.name: LORD DARLINGTON
